name: LaF3 tysonite, neutron refinement
citation: A. K. Cheetham, B. E. F. Fender, H. Fuess and A. F. Wright (1976). A powder neutron diffraction study of lanthanum and cerium trifluorides. Acta Crystallographica B32, 94-97.
conditions_evidence: Numeric diffraction temperature and pressure are not specified in the original deposited CIF and have not been verified from full text; both remain unknown.
method: Experimental powder neutron diffraction structure of synthetic LaF3; unchanged COD/AMCSD0009547 deposition.
synthesis_conditions_note: The CIF identifies the sample as synthetic; specific synthesis conditions not verified.
selection: Selected experimental reference; no FEFF calculation or experimental EXAFS validation performed in source research.
notes: Retains the full 9+2 F coordination envelope: nine F at 2.421-2.638 A and two more at 2.999 A; the next F occurs at 3.986 A. Do not silently discard the two longer contacts.
The trailing Chem 5 (1966) 1466-1468 text in the original CIF title is retained in raw bytes, but is not part of the verified 1976 article citation.
The source has no atomic occupancy column; full occupancy is the parser/default crystallographic interpretation, not a separately refined occupancy result.

Lanthanide L3 paths are EXAFS candidates, not validated white-line, multiplet, magnetic, or XANES models. FEFF8.2 documents frozen-f density by default and possible f-element SCF convergence difficulties; retain the actual engine recipe and logs.
